dict.string: AeroDock detects earbuds connecting and disconnecting to show their status immediately.
AeroDock shows a live mirror only when you open the camera mirror. No video is recorded or uploaded.
AeroDock records voice notes only when you press Start recording. Audio is saved locally on your Mac.
AeroDock controls playback and displays the current song when you connect Spotify or Apple Music.
AeroDock displays your upcoming events. It does not create, change, or upload calendar events.
